content: Homage to the noble Mañjuśrī.This is known as "The Chinese Method for Averting Periodic Obstacles."Homage to all the noble ones.May all the Vidyās grant protection.Homage to all the supreme ones.May the deities of the sky grant protection.Homage to the deities of the Brahmā lineage.To those who rule over the existence of the three realms,I prostrate to all and present offerings.Every day is auspicious.All constellations are favorable.All Buddhas possess great miraculous powers.By these words of truth,May we all be well and happy at all times.Oṃ vāgīśvari muṃ. Oṃ maṇi padme hūṃ. Oṃ vajrapāṇi hūṃ. Oṃ mahe dpal 'bar ma ye svāhā. Oṃ mahākāli mo ta ye svāhā. Oṃ a ka ni ni ka ni a bi yi maṇḍale svāhā. Oṃ zindu, protect! Oṃ du du na, protect! Oṃ dar du, protect! Oṃ tsu ti, protect! Oṃ du ma, protect! Oṃ pra ti, protect! Oṃ su dā dan tri, protect! Oṃ na tshan, protect! Oṃ su la kha, protect! Oṃ kha la tri, protect! Oṃ tre du she du, protect! Oṃ kha ti, protect! Oṃ ltar ltar, protect! Oṃ ma pa sha ye, protect! Oṃ ka nanta, protect! Oṃ bha la, protect! Oṃ ta la bha, protect! Oṃ ra, protect! Oṃ ra tri, protect! Oṃ ma ra, protect! Oṃ ma rig, protect! Oṃ smṛ ti, protect! Oṃ ta ne, protect! Oṃ bha ta, protect!Cause of the protector of the three realms, pi pi ling ga ga rjes la gi, establish the molten-metal benefit for the abode of human beings. Protect and guard me, O deities, from the abodes of the harmonious and disharmonious, the auspicious and inauspicious, and the physical manifestations. Oṃ trag tu tre ye svāhā. Oṃ tre'u zlog. Oṃ trag rakṣa zlog. Oṃ ma ma gyi ta zlog. Oṃ ma surya zlog. Oṃ a candra ye svāhā. Oṃ pu pa ra ta ye svāhā. Oṃ pri ti sha ti svāhā. Oṃ ma ma sngo ta sngo ta ye svāhā. Oṃ ma ma ram ram ye svāhā. Oṃ ma ma kar kar ye svāhā. Oṃ ma ma char chur yar yer svāhā. Oṃ ma ma su su tam tam ye svāhā.Oṃ yaṃ yaṃ sa la ge re du ye te khu che phaṭ. Zhi zhi yang du mahā raṃ raṃ ge ra tsa sa phaṭ. Gha dha seng ge zhi ba 'dus. Na ma sa du ye ma ra da ke khang de 'du. Ba ro si ma du hri. Nag mo chems kham du a a ma da pe rim. Khreng du ma a ra khyer na yu. A haṃ khye sha na ma ma ho. A pa sa ra sa rakṣa hūṃ. O ma rakṣa. Ma ra hūṃ hūṃ bharya dha ma ma ye. Dha ke ca ra ya phaṭ. Subdue the hostile forces of the five elements for me and fully protect me. Oṃ a ga ni dha ra sha ma ra ya sa bcings ma tra kre ya na ya phaṭ. Nag po zhi glu ta ya. Ma ta ya mal mal zhi zhi svāhā. Ā yu ra yu te a kur zhi ha le. Sa su tri phaṭ. Oṃ oṃ hūṃ ke raṃ te phaṭ. Dha dha na ma sa ra ma sa te. Da ha na na hūṃ hūṃ zhi zhi mal mal zhag po zhi. Pur he ni ha ha na sāhā. Zhi dha lam du sa se phaṭ. Me a rakṣa si ma du ye. Nag po zhi sa ma ye a na phaṭ. Gu ma gu te nag po zhi. Oṃ hūṃ sarva rakṣa hūṃ. Dha dha na dha ho. Me he ma ho rakṣa rbad. Zhi zhi dul dul svāhā. Lhan. Oṃ namo buddhāya. Namo dharmāya. Namo saṃghāya. A ne na te. Tadyathā. A ka ra na sad. Svabha sa pra dharma ni sa. Sarva tathā. Oṃ shodha bi pu sha. Bi ma le tsa le. Ru lu ru lu. Bi shi taṃ manta. O laṃ mu. Sa ra ja ye svāhā. Oṃ tra ya mig tir ye svāhā. Oṃ tra ma le svāhā. Oṃ traṃ bhe la rā ja ye svāhā. punishments of broken oaths, hexing diagrams, and evil mantras.May all adverse conditions, without exception, be pacified.The dhāraṇī known as "The Chinese Method for Averting Periodic Obstacles," spoken by the noble Mañjuśrī, is complete. Sarva maṅgalaṃ.
